newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan twins plant trees, play golf at age 105.
newsitem.headline: Japan twins plant trees, play golf at age 105.

text.p: Celebrity twins Kin and Gin wielded shovels and putters as they celebrated their 105th birthday on Friday by planting trees and making their first attempt at golf.

The twins, Kin Narita and Gin Kanie, displayed the earthy cackles and quips that have made them household names in Japan during an outing to boost a forestry conservation group in Yamanashi prefecture, a mountainous area just west of Tokyo.
Asked the secret to their longevity, Gin said: "I don't know for sure, but at this age I walk for two hours each morning for exercise." Her sister said she did the same.
Standing and walking unassisted, Kin and Gin -- whose names mean gold and silver in Japanese -- used spades of those colours to turn over earth to plant Japanese cypresses and other trees.
Using gold- and silver-coloured putters, the frail-looking women sunk putts at a local golf course and released carp in their namesake colours into a nearby lake.
The twins, born in 1892, have become celebrities through regular appearances in television commercials.
